question: What discharge capacity did the recovered NMC622 show after its C/3 cycling, what share of the baseline capacity was that, and what baseline capacity does that imply?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%mah%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%retention%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%%\%%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND id BETWEEN 'p6.L18' AND 'p6.L31' ORDER BY id

WITH t AS (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L28') SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) / (CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE)/100) AS baseline_mah_g, regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS cap, regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS share, regexp_extract(text, 'after ([0-9]+) cycles', 1) AS cycles FROM t
